deduplication_rules: Multiple diagnostics of the same endpoint are one evidence family, not independent replications.
Synthetic recovery, schema, coverage, identifiability and observation audits are D0 and never counted as ecological support.
Interim point-estimate receipts are superseded by their frozen inferential receipt.
The strict-epoch and canonical Signy Adelie concentration receipts are one external population evidence family.
Paper 2 design/recovery receipts collapse to one real-outcome ecological inference family.

supported: prospectively replicated breeding-space concentration in Signy Adelie and chinstrap after Palmer discovery
strong shared long-term Palmer decline as regional context
robust but nonpredictive conditional N_eff association as secondary mechanism trace

program_level_routes_not_counted: Routes without a final results/*.json receipt at the frozen main SHA belong in a separate not-executed/no-final-receipt appendix and must not alter the 66 count.
